in_sanskrit.name: मुञ्चुन्
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who rides a vehicle or travels

in_hindi.name: मुञ्चून
in_hindi.long_meaning: Person who is on a journey or a traveler

in_tamil.name: முஞ்சுன்
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who travels on a vehicle or in a vehicle

in_telugu.name: ముఞ్చున్
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who is always on the move or always traveling

in_marathi.name: Munchun
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Munchun हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Munchun is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Manas', meaning mind, and 'Chund', meaning Lord of wealth. In Hindu mythology, Munchun is a Yaksha, a nature deity who is the guardian of wealth and prosperity.

in_bengali.name: Munchun
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of wealth
in_bengali.long_meaning: Munchun একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Munchun is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Manas', meaning mind, and 'Chund', meaning Lord of wealth. In Hindu mythology, Munchun is a Yaksha, a nature deity who is the guardian of wealth and prosperity.
